final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out * out <= n and (out + 1) * (out + 1) > n
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(8) == 2
  ex isqrt(9) == 3
  if n == 0
    0
  else
    var low = 1
    var high = n
    var ans = 1
    while low <= high
      let mid = low + (high - low) // 2
      if mid <= n // mid
        ans = mid
        low = mid + 1
      else
        high = mid - 1
    ans
